title: claude-lcls launcher ignores other software's variables
result: 24/24 PASS (corrected re-run) · recorded take: 24 PASS, 3 test-design FAIL re-checked PASS
summary: A shell exporting ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=yourKeyHere made the live installer sit silent for three minutes and every claude-lcls request fail with a 401. The new launcher and installer pass in that same shell, and also hold up against a Bedrock switch, a bogus gateway URL, a repo pinning Opus 5 and a stale settings.json.
